newsitem.title: USA: US growth and low inflation possible--KC Fed chief.
newsitem.headline: US growth and low inflation possible--KC Fed chief.

text.p: The performance of the U.S. economy suggests the nation can have positive growth with falling inflation, said the president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Thomas Hoenig.
"Over the last couple of years, we have actually seen the economy run very healthy with inflation actually coming down," Hoenig told an audience of businessmen gathered here.
"Over the entire expansion, inflation has averaged 3.1 or so percent on an annual basis ... We actually know that we can have very good growth with inflation coming down," he added.
The Kansas City Fed chief said economic growth appeared to have moderated in the second quarter after a sizzling 5.9 percent growth rate in the first three months of the year.
